notes.title: Spellbearers - Patch 2.3 Notes
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch 2.3 Notes[/b][/u]

Hi everyone, here are the Patch 2.3 notes for Spellbearers.

To report an issue, please leave a message on the Steam Discussion Board or on our Whim Indie Discord.

[b]Patch Notes[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Cloud support has been enabled for Spellbearers. Cloud saving will now activate when the game has closed. [b]Please note that any saved progress and the in-game achievement tracker from Version 1.0 and 1.1 is incompatible with this new build  and any current progress will be deleted upon updating.[/b] Previously earned Steam achievements are not affected. This was due to a change in the save file structure. We apologize for any inconvenience, and request to finish any current playthroughs before updating. 

[*] Mouse Support has been added, and you can now left-click to select options, characters, and shoot missiles. Please note that Mouse Support is only for Player 1. Player 2 must use a gamepad or compatible controller. The mouse can be turned off from Keyboard Settings in Options. 

[*] Minor optimizations have been made to "The Minansi" boss.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Hey everyone! Patch 1.1 is now live, and we have implemented the following changes. For those who would like to continue playing Spellbearers on the original launch normal difficulty, please opt-in to the "old normal" beta branch on Steam settings.


[Patch 1.1 Notes]

« Game Changes / General »

* In all modes/difficulties, immunities for enemies have been removed and changed to be highly resistant instead. 

* In all modes/difficulties, the ice physics in the "Icy Realm of Pagosia" has been changed.
* "Easy" mode has been renamed to "Practice" mode. 
* Achievement text color has been changed to white.
* Added "Achievements and "Options" to the top of the respective screens.
* The Achievements window has been clarified to say that Achievements cannot be earned in Practice Mode.

« Game Changes / Hard Mode »

* Players that begin a new game on Hard Mode will start with 10 lives instead of 5.
* Please note that aside from the changes to immunities, the new changes in Normal mode are not applied to Hard mode.

« Game Changes / Normal+Practice Mode » 

* Players that begin a new game on will now start with 15 lives.
* An invincibility window has been added for monsters that do not spawn from a doorway.
* The warning/despawn rate of spells has been lengthened. 
* The health of certain enemies has been reduced.



« Bug Fixes » 

* An issue where the default movement configuration was set to arrow keys has been addressed. This can be modified in the Configuration settings.
* Minor text and phrases have been fixed.
* An issue where the player selection screen would change colors when a spell was collected has been addressed.

« Known Issues » 

* There is currently an issue if keys are rebinded from the main menu where it looks like the settings are reset when the player accesses Options again in-game. We are currently looking at a fix for this.


Thank you very much, and we hope you enjoy Spellbearers!

-Whim Independent Studios

notes.title: Spellbearers Steam Fest Livestream! Today @ 5PM-6PM PST!
notes.content:
The Dev team is going live with a playthrough of Spellbearers! The game is officially finished and ready for release! Now experience some of the Couch Co-op fun that is coming your way!  Join in via Twitch or our Steam Broadcast and get a first look at the fully developed game and some of its secrets! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37955905/a438636173e5f71b26a78c590d5237a4e3b7a7d8.gif[/img]

[h1]Spellbearers[/h1] is a top-down, 2D, twin-stick shooter inspired by "Super Smash TV". Battle against hordes of magical enemies to liberate the rulers of three kingdoms that have been overtaken by dark forces. With staff in hand, do you have what it takes to uphold the title of The Spellbearer?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37955905/7de729defa9b4f62a0a2f2e5548980a5c4b005d5.gif[/img]

[h2]STORY[/h2]
Darkness sweeps over the mythical world of Spellbourne, out of which emerge beasts and monsters that were said to have long been banished. An evil force has brought them back and must be stopped. This darkness has invaded the three ruling kingdoms of Spellbourne, their rulers overtaken and transformed into hideous and destructive monsters. If there is to be any hope in defeating this evil, all three kingdoms must be saved by restoring the rulers back to their original forms.


Amid the ensuing chaos, Four legendary heroes arise to take up the call. Destined to forever shoulder the burdens of magic, they are known only as the Spellbearers.

[h1]Join Us on Twitch! Today @ 5PM-6PM PST![/h1]
